purpose: Teach: 腹筋/退治/金髪/トウモロコシ/ねずみ/かぼちゃ/ウイスキー/サウナ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、毎朝腹筋運動なさってるんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer does abs exercises every morning, you know.
lines.style: Gentle, observational tone. Sharing something she's noticed. Warm curiosity — not gossiping, just noticing. Soft delivery, like she's thinking out loud to Aoi.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店のゴキブリ退治、業者さんに頼みましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should call a professional to handle the roaches in the shop.
lines.style: Practical, direct but not sharp. Lean into the 'should' — this is the sensible move. Warm and matter-of-fact, like she's already thought this through. No drama, just solution.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、金髪に染められて素敵ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer looks so lovely with their blonde hair, don't they?
lines.style: Genuine admiration with a lift in the voice. Soft emphasis on 'lovely.' Not fawning — this is simple appreciation. Invite Aoi to notice it too.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューにトウモロコシのスープを加えましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should add corn soup to the new menu.
lines.style: Lighter, more energized than before. A suggestion that excites her. Lean into the idea — this would be good. A touch of brightness, like she can already picture it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店にねずみがいないか確認しましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's make sure there aren't any mice in the shop.
lines.style: Practical concern, but not alarmist. Direct instruction wrapped in care. Steady, focused tone — this needs checking. Not rushed, just clear about what matters.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、ハロウィン限定でかぼちゃのデザートを作りましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: We could make a special Halloween pumpkin dessert.
lines.style: Warm and animated. Playful energy lifting the idea up. Lean into the seasonal possibility — this would be fun. Light pace, almost like she's already tasting it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、夜はウイスキーを召し上がるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer drinks whisky in the evenings, apparently.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective. Sharing an observation about someone's private routine. Gentle tone — understanding without judgment. A little wondering, like she's piecing together who they are.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、毎週サウナに通ってらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: I heard that customer goes to the sauna every week.
lines.style: Soft, reflective close. Trailing off gently at the end. Noticing in a way that feels intimate — she's learning about this person. Warm, almost fond tone. The natural end of a quiet conversation.
